concerns.text: Task T004 (Synthetic code generation) requires stratification by `repo_activity_level` quartiles, but `repo_activity_level` is only computed later in Task T005. This forward dependency makes T004 unexecutable in Phase 1 as written.

Task T006 (Synthetic review‑timestamp simulation) depends on matched human PRs from the upcoming matching step (Phase 2, Task T009). Since matching has not been performed yet, the required KDE cannot be built, rendering T006 unexecutable in its current order.
